findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md:32 still says the built-in `migration` and `B-43de` samples expose partial parent governance and needed rows. That conflicts with the B-e781 closure claim and the read-only status check `lattice parent_roadmap_status --storyId=B-43de --json`, which reports `allRowsClosed=true`, `openRows=[]`, and `summaryClass=full_roadmap_complete` for B-43de. This leaves the scoped Parent Roadmap doc internally inconsistent about whether B-43de M4-M12 is closed or still partial/open.

docs/requirements/decisions/parent-roadmap-intent-totality-gate-execution-plan.md still has a current-looking M7 test expectation at lines 525-530 that says B-43de migrates to partial parent governance with open child rows, while the current status and execution-order sections at lines 32-33 and 592-609 say B-e781 closed B-43de M4-M12 and parent_roadmap_status now reports allRowsClosed=true/full_roadmap_complete. Because B-3f74 is specifically syncing boundary status after B-e781, this leaves contradictory B-43de boundary wording in the same document.
